verdict_detail: The REPORTED defect is fixed and proven 3/3 (the working coupon survives an invalid apply; RemoveCoupon is absent from the wire). REOPENED because the interaction the fix produces ends in a bad state: the 'This code is not valid' error never clears. couponError is a MODULE-SCOPE ref outside the composable, reset only by clearError() at the top of applyCoupon/removeCoupon; clearError is exported but no component destructures or calls it. So the error survives typing, blur, cart updates, and route changes (module state outlives unmount) — it clears only on a subsequent apply/remove or a page reload. Byte-identical on dev and the fix branch, so PRE-EXISTING and not introduced by the fix — but newly load-bearing: pre-fix the invalid apply also mutated the cart, so the error accompanied a real state change; post-fix a stale error is the ONLY outcome. Operator decision 2026-08-05: in scope for this ticket, reopen rather than file separately. Established from source (dev + PR head + coupons-section.vue/coupon-card.vue); no live re-run — operator accepted source evidence.
